figma_flow_operations_total.help: Total terminal Figma Flow control operations by task kind, operation, and state.

figma_flow_operation_queue_ms.help: Control operation queue wait duration from enqueue to plugin claim in milliseconds.

figma_flow_operation_plugin_ms.help: Plugin execution duration from claim to terminal result in milliseconds.

figma_flow_operation_e2e_ms.help: End-to-end operation duration from enqueue to completion in milliseconds.

figma_flow_readback_bytes.help: Accepted plugin readback JSON payload size in bytes.

figma_flow_plugin_online.help: Whether an authenticated Figma plugin poll was observed within the relay TTL (1=online, 0=offline).

figma_flow_plugin_last_seen_age_seconds.help: Seconds since the last authenticated Figma plugin poll (-1 if never observed in this session).

figma_flow_plugin_runtime_current.help: Whether the observed plugin runtime matches the workspace expected generation (1=current, 0=stale/unverified).

figma_flow_active_operation_age_seconds.help: Age in seconds of the currently active pending or claimed operation (0 if idle).

figma_flow_uncertain_operations.help: Number of unresolved uncertain mutating operations blocking further writes.

figma_flow_profile_needs_setup.help: Whether the latest relay profile reports needsSetup=true (1=needs setup, 0=configured or unknown).

figma_flow_live_changes_total.help: Total ingested live Figma Design page change events by change type and origin.

figma_flow_live_change_gaps_total.help: Total live Figma Design change stream gaps or unavailability notifications by reason.

figma_flow_tasks_prepared_total.help: Total workspace task prepare invocations by task kind and outcome status.

figma_flow_workspace_tasks_count.help: Current number of prepared tasks in the workspace catalogue by task kind.

figma_flow_quality_checks_total.help: Total pre-Figma design quality evaluations by pass/fail and strict mode.

figma_flow_quality_issues_total.help: Total design quality errors and warnings recorded by severity.

figma_flow_native_read_ms.help: Fresh native read benchmark durations in milliseconds by workload and state.

figma_flow_metrics_export_total.help: Total metrics sink export attempts by sink id and status.

figma_flow_metrics_queue_dropped_total.help: Total metrics items dropped due to bounded per-sink queue overflow.
